newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ascend Communications begun.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ascend Communications begun.

text.p: EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it initiated coverage on network access products company Ascend Communications Inc with outperform ratings in both the intermediate and long term.
-- Target price is $83 in the intermediate term and $100 in the long term. Ascend stock was up 2-1/16 at 54-3/4 Tuesday.
-- The company completed a merger June 30 with Cascade Communications.

-- "We believe the company will benefit from strengthening its customer base of Internet Service Providers and telephone companies, as well as benefit from a broader product portfolio," analyst Christin Armacost said in a research note.
